spec.title: API request count
spec.description: Shows the number of requests grouped by method

spec.expr: sum by (method) (count_over_time({app="flask-app"} |= "➡️ Incoming request" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | json [$__range]))

spec.title: Error logs
spec.description: Shows only error logs, with status code greather than 400

spec.expr: {app="flask-app"} |= "Response sent" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | json | label_format level="ERROR"  |  status_code >= 400 | line_format "🚨 HTTP {{.status_code}} ➔ {{.method}} {{.path}} ({{.latency_ms}} ms)"
sum(count_over_time({app="flask-app"} |= "Response sent" | json | line_format"{{.log}}" | json | status_code < 400 [1m])) / sum(count_over_time({app="flask-app"} |= "Response sent" [1m])) * 100

spec.title: Sync time
spec.description: Shows the variation of db sync time within selected time range

spec.expr: max(max_over_time({app="postgresql-ha"} |~ `checkpoint complete` | json | line_format `{{.log}}` | regexp `sync=(?P<sync_time>[0-9.]+) s` | unwrap sync_time | __error__=`` [$__auto]))

spec.title: Max sync time
spec.description: Shows the max db sync time within selected time range

spec.expr: max(max_over_time({app="postgresql-ha"} |~ "checkpoint complete" | regexp `sync=(?P<sync_time>[0-9.]+) s` | unwrap sync_time | __error__="" [$__auto]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="postgresql-ha"} |~ "(checkpoint|restartpoint) complete" | regexp `wrote (?P<buffers>[0-9]+) buffers` | unwrap buffers | __error__="" [$__auto]))
{app="postgresql-ha"} |= "started streaming WAL" | regexp `at (?P<lsn>[a-fA-F0-9/]+) on timeline (?P<timeline>\d+)` | line_format "🔄 REPLICA SYNC ➔ Timeline: {{.timeline}} | Start LSN: {{.lsn}}"

spec.title: HPA replicas
spec.description: Tracks the real-time status of the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, displaying the current number of active pods against the maximum allowed limit.

spec.title: CPU usage (per pod)
spec.description: Displays the real-time CPU consumption for each individual pod, measured in cores, highlighting load distribution across replicas.

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Visualizes the active working set memory utilized by each pod, which is crucial for identifying memory leaks or observing the high-water mark during stress tests.

spec.title: Incoming requests
spec.description: Detailed info of latest requests

spec.expr: {app="flask-app"} |~ "Incoming request|Response sent" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | json | label_format level=levelname | line_format "{{if .status_code}}⬅️ OUT ➔ {{.method}} {{.path}} (HTTP {{.status_code}}, {{.latency_ms}} ms){{else}}➡️ IN  ➔ {{.method}} {{.path}}{{end}}"

spec.title: Network I/O
spec.description: Tracks the inbound and outbound network traffic across the Minikube node, representing the actual load generated by external requests and Locust test users.

spec.title: Number of application pod restarts (5m range)
spec.description: Monitors container restart counts to detect crash loops and assess application stability under varying loads.

spec.title: CPU pressure (stall time)
spec.description: Measures PSI (Pressure Stall Information), indicating the exact amount of time the pod's execution was delayed or frozen due to Kubernetes CPU resource limits.

spec.title: Node CPU utilization (%)
spec.description: Percentage of aggregate vCPU capacity currently utilized by the Minikube node.

spec.title: Node Memory Utilization (%)
spec.description: Percentage of allocated RAM currently utilized relative to the total node capacity.

spec.title: Node Disk Utilization (%)
spec.description: Percentage of primary storage capacity currently consumed on the cluster volume.

spec.title: Running pods
spec.description: Displays the aggregate count of all pods currently in the 'Running' phase across all namespaces within the Kubernetes cluster.

spec.title: Node Memory Usage (GB)
spec.description: Absolute RAM consumption in Gigabytes measured against the fixed maximum limit.

spec.title: Node CPU Usage (Cores)
spec.description: Absolute vCPU core consumption measured against the fixed node capacity.

spec.title: Node Disk Usage (GB)
spec.description: Absolute storage space consumed in Gigabytes on the main virtual filesystem (/dev/sde).

spec.expr: avg(avg_over_time({app="flask-app"} |= `⬅️ Response sent` | json | line_format `{{.log}}` | json | unwrap latency_ms [1m]))

spec.title: Disk I/O Throughput (MB/s)
spec.description: Real-time combined read and write throughput on the primary node filesystem.

spec.expr: sum by (status_code) (count_over_time({app="flask-app"} |= "⬅️ Response sent" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | json [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {app="flask-app"} |= "⬅️ Response sent" | regexp `latency_ms[\\":\s]+(?P<latency_ms>[0-9.]+)` | unwrap latency_ms | __error__="" [$__auto])

spec.title: Database workload
spec.description: Shows the numer of SQL queries executed

spec.title: SQL executed
spec.description: Shows all SQL queries executed (except Kubernetes healthchecks)

spec.expr: {app="flask-app"} |= `🔍 Executing SQL` !~ `SELECT 1` | json | line_format `{{.log}}` | json | label_format level=levelname | line_format `🌐 {{.method}} {{.path}}  ➔  {{.message}} [{{.sql_query}}]`

spec.title: Top 5 endpoints
spec.description: Excluded paths: /, /favicon.ico, /api/health

spec.expr: topk(5, sum by (path) (count_over_time({app="flask-app"} |= "Response sent" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | json | path != "/", path != "/favicon.ico", path != "/api/health" [$__range])))
